title: Everything outside of the mall is scary
content: I've been going to mall world for thirty years and I swear every time I leave the mall and go anywhere else, it is scary as hell. One time I found my way back to my house and it was horrifying. It was like a scary attic that never ended and once I went in I knew there was no way out and horrible things were in every room. Even the mall world parking lot is dark and dangerous. Inside the mall is peaceful and fine (not paradise, but everything is fine). Is anyone else's mall world like that?
